description.en: The four rocky worlds closest to the Sun — Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars. Small, dense, and each strange in its own way.
description.hr: Cetiri stjenovita svijeta najbliza Suncu — Merkur, Venera, Zemlja i Mars. Mali, gusti, i svaki cudan na svoj nacin.

back.en: A rocky planet with a solid surface — Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars. The name comes from 'terra', Latin for earth.
back.hr: Stjenovita planeta s cvrstom povrsinom — Merkur, Venera, Zemlja i Mars. Ime dolazi od 'terra', latinski za zemlju.

front.en: Why does Mercury have such wild temperatures?
front.hr: Zasto Merkur ima tako divlje temperature?

back.en: With almost no atmosphere to hold heat, it swings from about 430 °C in daylight to -180 °C at night.
back.hr: Gotovo bez atmosfere da zadrzi toplinu, ide od oko 430 °C danju do -180 °C nocu.

media.image_hint: NASA MESSENGER snimak Merkura, cijeli disk. Trazi 'Mercury' na images.nasa.gov. Javno vlasnistvo.

front.en: Which planet is the hottest, and why?
front.hr: Koja je planeta najtoplija i zasto?

back.en: Venus. Its thick carbon-dioxide atmosphere traps heat in a runaway greenhouse effect — hotter than Mercury despite being farther from the Sun.
back.hr: Venera. Njena gusta atmosfera od ugljen-dioksida zadrzava toplinu u pobjeglom efektu staklenika — toplija od Merkura iako je dalja od Sunca.

media.image_hint: NASA/Magellan radarski globus Venere ili UV snimak. Trazi 'Venus globe' na images.nasa.gov. Provjeri licencu (vecina NASA javno vlasnistvo).

front.en: What's strange about a day on Venus?
front.hr: Sta je cudno kod dana na Veneri?

back.en: It's longer than its year, and the Sun rises in the west — Venus spins backwards compared to most planets.
back.hr: Duzi je od njene godine, a Sunce izlazi na zapadu — Venera se okrece unatrag u odnosu na vecinu planeta.

front.en: What makes Earth unique among the planets?
front.hr: Sto cini Zemlju jedinstvenom medju planetama?

back.en: It's the only known world with liquid water on its surface and life. So far, the only place in the universe we know is inhabited.
back.hr: Jedini poznati svijet s tekucom vodom na povrsini i zivotom. Zasad jedino mjesto u svemiru za koje znamo da je nastanjeno.

media.image_hint: NASA 'Blue Marble' snimak Zemlje. Trazi 'Blue Marble' na images.nasa.gov. Javno vlasnistvo.

front.en: Why is Mars called the Red Planet?
front.hr: Zasto se Mars zove Crvena planeta?

back.en: Its surface is rich in iron that has rusted, coating the planet in reddish dust visible even from Earth.
back.hr: Povrsina mu je bogata zeljezom koje je zahrdalo, prekrivajuci planetu crvenkastom prasinom vidljivom cak sa Zemlje.

media.image_hint: NASA/Hubble ili Viking snimak Marsa, cijeli disk. Trazi 'Mars full disk' na images.nasa.gov. Javno vlasnistvo.

front.en: Where is the tallest volcano in the Solar System?
front.hr: Gdje je najvisi vulkan u Suncevom sistemu?

back.en: On Mars — Olympus Mons, about 22 km high and as wide as Poland. Nearly three times taller than Everest.
back.hr: Na Marsu — Olympus Mons, visok oko 22 km i sirok kao Poljska. Gotovo tri puta visi od Everesta.

back.en: Yes, two tiny ones — Phobos and Deimos. They're lumpy and potato-shaped, likely captured asteroids.
back.hr: Da, dva sicusna — Phobos i Deimos. Kvrgavi su i u obliku krompira, vjerovatno zarobljeni asteroidi.

front.en: How does Mercury's size compare to Earth?
front.hr: Kolika je velicina Merkura u odnosu na Zemlju?

back.en: Mercury is the smallest planet — only about 38% of Earth's diameter, barely bigger than our Moon.
back.hr: Merkur je najmanja planeta — samo oko 38% Zemljinog promjera, jedva veci od naseg Mjeseca.

front.en: Could humans ever live on Mars?
front.hr: Bi li ljudi ikad mogli zivjeti na Marsu?

back.en: It's the most Earth-like planet, but has thin air, no breathable oxygen and harsh radiation. Any settlers would need sealed habitats.
back.hr: Najslicnija je Zemlji, ali ima rijedak zrak, nema kisika za disanje i jako zracenje. Svaki doseljenik trebao bi zatvorena stanista.

front.en: Why does Venus shine so brightly in our sky?
front.hr: Zasto Venera tako sjajno sija na nasem nebu?

back.en: Its thick clouds reflect sunlight superbly. After the Moon, Venus is often the brightest object in the night sky — the 'Morning' or 'Evening Star'.
back.hr: Njeni gusti oblaci izvrsno reflektuju suncevu svjetlost. Poslije Mjeseca, Venera je cesto najsjajniji objekt na nocnom nebu — 'Zvijezda Danica' ili 'Vecernjaca'.
